name: com.ugo9.runtime
description: Ugo9 2D characters: the C core computes a few hundred bytes per character, the GPU deforms every vertex, and many characters draw in a few calls.

samples.description: Open and press Play: the sample character with animation buttons, a slider per parameter, blinking, the microphone moving the mouth, and the part under a click.
A crowd in one batch and a character that looks at the mouse.
One character in a conversation: looks at the mouse, blinks, 1-9 expressions (preset basic.ug9x), hold Space to talk, A switches animations with a mix.
Draws the engine test scenes and saves PNGs to compare with the Web runtime (node tests/unity_test.mjs).
Measures fps, main-thread CPU time, draw calls and memory for 50 to 6400 characters in a fixed grid (docs/比較_Live2D.md).
